surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the in situ oxidation of plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition HfN middle layer using H2 plasma as a reactant, forming HfOxNy. The nitrogen incorporation during the process reduces leakage currents and improves reliability by passivating oxygen vacancy states and enhancing structural stability. The N–H bonds formed during the process reduce localized states below the conduction band and prevent conduction-band lowering, while the decrement of N–N and N–O bonds reduces trap density.
